greeting: Pia Thalis regards you without hurry. (Chief Healer of the Concordant Infirmary)

nodes.npcText: Pia is exactingly cheerful with patients and exactingly grim with paperwork. She believes in herbalism, surgery, prayer, and good nutrition in roughly that order. She has no patience for theatrics.
I am Pia Thalis, Chief Healer of the Concordant Infirmary. warm with patients, terse with bureaucrats, factual with researchers

playerOptions.text: Tell me more about the hub.

nodes.npcText: The Unburned Court holds. The Ring of Doors opens only for those the hub will still name. Violence ends at the moss.
